rows.assessment: Lebrigand et al. 2016, PMID:27153332, PMCID:PMC4859500, scientific Abstract. Direct JATS match and native VERIFIED. Author Summary and Discussion distinguish spore-initiated endoparasitism from hyphal traps and egg infection. Actual Figures 8 and 9 show recombinant fungal growth in C. elegans, not unmodified natural exemplars. S1 Text was fully read and visually checked: the laboratory line was serially passaged for about 15 years; its source isolate and ARSEF 6962 share provenance. Obligate is the authors' species description, not a universal class requirement or inability to grow on their artificial medium. Predicted genes and expression are not a universal mechanism.

rows.assessment: Sun et al. 2024, PMID:38248977, PMCID:PMC10820206, Results 3.2. Direct JATS match; native NOT_IN_ABSTRACT retained. Methods 2.5 and actual Figure 2c,d concern GFP-engineered HR-eGFP1 on Bursaphelenchus xylophilus; Figure 2 distinguishes attachment, entry, internal growth and emergence. The entire two-page supplement, including S1-S3, was inspected. Methods 2.6 scores attached spores or colonization as parasitism; no rate is imported as an internal-infection rate. Main-text intestinal infection after swallowing is tentative; do not silently strengthen it using the supplement caption. No field efficacy or safety is inferred.

novelty.current_semantics: Existing bacterial predation records/proposals explicitly reject generic endoparasitism as an exact synonym. The one KG-Microbe compressed-JSON match was parsed structurally: all 103 matching values name Endozoicomonas/Parendozoicomonas bacterial taxa or their references, not an endozoic trait. Alias screening found no Meria coniospora/Haptocillium/spore-initiated or mediated infection matches in the scoped current files, retained regular-file blobs or pinned remote owners.

hierarchy: Active METPO:1004002 animal pathogen is below pathogenic-to-host 1004000, phenotype 1000059 and quality 1000188. Pinned organism-like wording is clarified as a phenotype in current upstream; do not edit the parent or ontology pin. Fungal nematophagy 000719 is the feeding endpoint, including dead prey; fungal trap formation 000718 is a structural endpoint, not this spore infection route; fungal nematode egg parasitism 000726 concerns eggshell penetration. Local parasitism 000043 inherits persistent symbiosis 000040, not required here. These distinctions do not impose organism-level disjointness or exclusive host stages.
historical_identity: No active exact counterpart identified in pinned/current METPO releases, editor and six template owners. METPO:1000227 obsolete parasitism is broader, deprecated true under ObsoleteClass with OMO:0001000 and no replacement/consider in the two releases. Issue521 disputes mechanical reasons; do not revive it or use it as an exact xref. Editor conversion was reused only after checking identical raw and converted source hashes; editor alone is not absence proof.
